summary: Story roll-up for poc-responsiveness on the merged tree. All 18 plan contracts across the three tasks verdict IMPLEMENTED, each carried from that task's own sealed review, and all three closed at 10/approve on every lens (#47, #48, #49). verify.py passes across structural, typecheck, quality and test. The story took 3 tasks and 8 review rounds. Its defining feature is how often a cold read or a lens corrected the ORCHESTRATOR'S OWN artifacts rather than the implementer's: the plan was unsaveable without decision frontmatter; a task split put backend cancellation inside a frontend task; a required port method would have failed typecheck across fourteen implementers; a gated proof would have silently skipped; and the confirmed spec had to be amended three times to stop contradicting shipped code.
non_blocking_findings: D-0024 and D-0031 remain open, so every leaf in this story was judged by its junit testcase NAME and EXECUTED count rather than an exit code.

frontend-design was never read by any delegate run across three user-facing tasks in this project, despite a lesson naming an absolute path verified to exist. The orchestrator read and applied it directly each time; on this story it found no defect, on the previous one it found raw ApiError text rendered to users.
